content.value_statement: Textbook chatbots need a clear connection between the chat interface, retrieval flow, and source content. This guide outlines a RAG design using an API route, embeddings, Qdrant search, and a responsive chat component.
actual_capabilities: Describe an API route that receives a user query and conversation history.
Outline embedding-based retrieval of relevant textbook chunks from Qdrant.
Describe building model context from retrieved matches before response generation.
Identify a floating chatbot component with size controls and Markdown responses.
Document contextual questions from highlighted text and responsive mobile behavior.
Describe dark and light theme compatibility for the chatbot UI.
limitations: It is a design reference and does not include implementation code.
It does not configure Qdrant, embeddings, model credentials, or deployment.
It does not define retrieval quality metrics, access control, or evaluation procedures.
It does not provide data ingestion or textbook chunking instructions.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline how a query is embedded and matched against textbook chunks in Qdrant.

prompt_templates.title: Specify the chat component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a feature checklist for a responsive textbook chatbot UI with Markdown responses and context selection.

prompt_templates.title: Review the full design
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my textbook chatbot architecture. Identify missing pieces across API handling, vector retrieval, response context, UI behavior, and themes.

output: Receive the user query and history.
Create an embedding for the query.
Retrieve relevant textbook chunks from Qdrant.
Build context from the matches and generate a response.

output_examples.input: What should the chatbot UI include?
output: A floating chat window with size controls.
Markdown response rendering and highlighted-text questions.
Responsive layout, user-aware answers, and light or dark theme support.

best_practices: Keep retrieved textbook content separate from conversation history when building model context.
Show source information for retrieved content when the product requires traceable answers.
Test the chat component on mobile screens and in both supported themes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat this reference as a complete production implementation.
Do not send unbounded conversation history or retrieval results to the response model.
Do not personalize answers without defining appropriate user data and access controls.

faq.question: What does this skill document?
faq.answer: It documents the intended backend, Qdrant retrieval, and UI design for a textbook RAG chatbot.

faq.question: Does it include source code?
faq.answer: No. It describes file locations and behaviors but does not provide implementation code.

faq.question: Which vector database does it reference?
faq.answer: It references Qdrant for storing and searching textbook embeddings.

faq.question: Which models can generate responses?
faq.answer: The document mentions Gemini Flash or Pro for response generation and Gemini or OpenAI embeddings.

faq.question: Can users ask about selected text?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented UI includes context selection from highlighted text.

faq.question: Does it address production security?
faq.answer: No. You must separately design authentication, authorization, data handling, and model credential controls.
